title: 23-Year-Old Built AI Apps Making $50M/Year 💰
description:
Blake Anderson was just 23 when he built CalAI — an AI app that scans your food and tells you the calories. That single app now generates over $50 million per year.

He didn't have a tech background. He didn't raise venture capital. He just found a problem people cared about, built a simple AI solution, and scaled it through viral marketing on TikTok.

This is proof that you don't need to be a big tech company to win in AI. Indie developers are building real businesses with AI tools right now.
